rules.name: save-before-closing
rules.why: Never lose work on quit. Verified 2026-10-14: Yes saves the set and Live exits.

rules.name: uad-no-hardware
rules.why: No UAD hardware on this PC; the notice blocks Live startup until OK. Seen 2026-10-14.

rules.name: recover-after-crash
rules.why: Live asks this on the first launch after a crash. Enter presses the default, Yes: recover, so no work is thrown away unattended. By key, not label, because OCR misses the highlighted Yes (it read only No, 2026-10-22).
